name: oblivion
description: Dashboard autoalojado, seguro y personalizable para tu homelab

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @oblivion/server" "npm run dev -w @oblivion/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oblivion/web && npm run build -w @oblivion/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @oblivion/server && npm run test -w @oblivion/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @oblivion/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @oblivion/server && npm run typecheck -w @oblivion/web
